page.overview:
Who is Fiona?

Fiona is a minor character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards. She is the daughter of Titan and Vanessa.

Fiona appears as a young African-American girl. She has braided pigtails with orange beads.

Fiona is portrayed as a compassionate, happy-go-lucky young girl who loves her parents deeply. Despite finally enjoying an improved life due to her father, she remained true to her authentic self and never let her newfound status show to others.

Fiona was born to Titan and Vanessa. From a very young age, she's been struggling with a physical ailment, to which she manages with specific medications.
